facts.text: Built in 1911 for Charles Lindley, president of the Foothill Ranch
In 1924 Mabelle Scott Anderson, owner of the Mabelle Scott Rancho School for Girls, acquired the house; it is named after both owners
Has hosted weddings, receptions, banquets and catering since 1978, open year-round
4 acres of gardens in Azusa, close to the San Gabriel Mountains
Gardens, rockwork, house and winding driveway are little changed since construction finished in 1911
An original hitching post stands between the house and the Carriage House
Ceremonies are held on the front lawn among old trees, including a cypress and a California live oak
The ceremony lawn centres on a wedding arch with the residence behind it, faces the San Gabriel Mountains and is ringed by trees and hedgerows
The garden holds up to 200 seated
Rooms in the residence are available for bridal photos before the ceremony: a foyer with antique furniture and a grand staircase up to a Victorian-style dressing room
The Carriage House was built in 2003 to match the house, seats 200, and is a two-minute walk through the gardens from the ceremony
All receptions are held in the Carriage House, maximum seating 200
Only one event per day
The Carriage House has its own commercial kitchen; meals are cooked on site by the house chef and served by staff
Outside vendors may add food only after the main entrée has been served
The wedding package covers what a reception needs; options are available on request
Ceremonies run an hour and a half and receptions five hours; extra time can be purchased
Vendors and couples may arrive from 11 AM to set up at no charge; set-up does not count against booked time
The house coordinator runs the on-site coordination; a personal coordinator may join in addition
Generally a 25% non-refundable deposit at booking, negotiable depending on circumstances
20% service charge on the meal cost
No open flames in the house or Carriage House; no rice, birdseed or confetti; real petals only; smoking outdoors in designated areas; amplified music indoors, outdoors with volume and time limits
Wedding facility includes a rehearsal, an in-house host, white garden chairs with set-up, a bridal arch, a dressing room, and the entry hall and grand staircase for pictures
Movie scenes, television episodes and commercials have been filmed at the house; on-site parking takes production vehicles and trailers
Also hosts quinceañeras, corporate events, birthdays, anniversaries and fundraisers
Extras at additional cost include extra time, valet parking, coloured linens, cocktail tables, hot hors d'oeuvres and chiavari chairs
Open for tours, by appointment

story.lead: A 1911 house, kept close to the day it was finished.
paragraphs: Built in 1911 for Charles Lindley, president of the Foothill Ranch, the house passed in 1924 to Mabelle Scott Anderson, who ran the Mabelle Scott Rancho School for Girls. It carries both their names.
The gardens, rockwork and winding drive have changed little since, and the original hitching post still stands between the house and the Carriage House. Weddings have been held here since 1978.

timeline.text: The house is built for Charles Lindley.
Mabelle Scott Anderson acquires the house.
The Carriage House is built to match.

faqs.q: How long are ceremonies and receptions?
faqs.a: Ceremonies run an hour and a half and receptions five hours, placed within the house's schedule. Extra time can be purchased.

faqs.q: How early can vendors arrive to set up?
faqs.a: From 11 AM, at no charge, and set-up does not count against your booked time. The bridal room opens at your scheduled arrival.

faqs.q: Can we bring our own coordinator?
faqs.a: Yes, in addition to the house coordinator, who handles the on-site coordination.

faqs.q: Can the reception be held on one of the lawns?
faqs.a: No. All receptions are held in the Carriage House.
Yes. Meals are cooked on site in the Carriage House kitchen and served by the house staff. Outside vendors may add food after the main entrée.

faqs.q: Can I arrive by horse and carriage?
faqs.a: Yes, with notice of your plans in advance.
Yes. The buildings, patio, gazebo, trees and some potted plants are lit.

faqs.q: What deposit do you ask for?
faqs.a: Generally 25% at booking, non-refundable, though it can be negotiated depending on circumstances.
Open flames in the house or Carriage House; rice, birdseed and confetti; artificial petals. Smoking is outdoors in designated areas, and amplified music outdoors has volume and time limits.

faqs.q: Can we take photos here without holding the wedding here?
faqs.a: Yes. Contact the house to arrange it.
